hints: Repeated occurrences correspond to suffixes with a common prefix.
In suffix order, suffixes sharing a prefix appear consecutively.
Find the largest value in the adjacent LCP array.
analogy: Two suffixes starting at different positions share a beginning exactly when that beginning repeats.
example: In banana, ana occurs at positions 2 and 4, so it is a longest repeated substring.
algorithm: Build the suffix array and its LCP array. Find the maximum LCP and output that many characters from either adjacent suffix. If the maximum is zero, report -1. Overlapping occurrences are allowed.
correctness: All occurrences of any repeated substring form a consecutive block in suffix order, so some adjacent pair shares it. Therefore the maximum adjacent LCP is at least as long as every repeated substring and itself is repeated.
complexity: For length n, O(n log n) time with a doubling suffix array and O(n) space.
